query: INSERT INTO comms_external_reactions(message_id,sender_id,display_name,emoji,revision,updated_at,user_id,source_id) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comms_messages WHERE id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL) ON CONFLICT(message_id,sender_id) DO UPDATE SET emoji=excluded.emoji,display_name=excluded.display_name,revision=excluded.revision,updated_at=excluded.updated_at,user_id=excluded.user_id,source_id=excluded.source_id WHERE (comms_external_reactions.revision,comms_external_reactions.source_id)<(excluded.revision,excluded.source_id)
